name: de.zugferdpruefer/zugferd-validator
title: ZUGFeRD & XRechnung Validator
description: Validate ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, and XRechnung XML invoices (EN 16931, BR-DE) and German Leitweg-IDs.

tools.name: validate_einvoice_xml
tools.description: Validate a ZUGFeRD 2.3, Factur-X, or XRechnung (UN/CEFACT CII or OASIS UBL 2.1) invoice XML document against EN 16931 and German BR-DE rules, including profile detection, mandatory BT fields, IBAN Mod-97, Leitweg-ID ISO 7064 Mod 97-10, line-item math, and net/tax/gross reconciliation.

xml.description: Raw ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, or XRechnung XML invoice document (CII CrossIndustryInvoice or UBL Invoice/CreditNote).

fileName.description: Optional filename label included in the validation report (defaults to invoice.xml).

tools.name: validate_leitweg_id
tools.description: Validate a German public-sector Leitweg-ID per ISO/IEC 7064 Mod 97-10 and identify the federal or state submission portal, or compute valid 2-digit check digits from grob and optional fein segments.

grob.description: Grobadressierung (2-12 digits starting with Bundesland/Bund code 01-16 or 99) to compute check digits when leitwegId is omitted.

fein.description: Optional Feinadressierung (up to 30 alphanumeric characters A-Z, 0-9) used with grob to compute check digits.
